items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I ran into Rosie Clooney about six months later and she’d been in Japan and she said, “I heard all about your peanut butter.”

ctx.x: No that’s a classic. There’s a peanut butter story too. When I went to Japan with Pat Boone and after the opening show generally in Tokyo, they take you over to this geisha place where the girls perform, you know I mean it’s not what people think, and then they serve a dinner. And they bring out these fish, blue fish and yellow fish and red fish and they’re lying on the plate looking up at you like this. And it wasn’t too appetizing. And I had this coat on with a bulge in it, and I asked the guy I said, “do you…
That’s great. Well I want to thank you for your time today.
